settings_sources.task windows: keydep.vocab (E54/E62): Pile train rows 0-32767, its marker token (lowest-id zero-count non-alphanumeric token), 41-token windows (anchors.HALF = 20) cut by kv.windows with the two written columns swapped: the pool word at 19, the trigger at 20, the label as a 42nd column read by data.LAST with ci_len 41 (copying.with_target, E62). Train windows from rows with index mod 5 != 0; the fit (train-word) and held-out (held-out-pair) windows from rows with index mod 5 == 0.
settings_sources.pool: plan: tokens of a space and letters whose lowercase and capitalised forms are both single tokens; the 400 pairs whose rarer form is most frequent in rows 0-32767 (the rarer form, so that both forms have Pile positions for the probe); split by pair 300 / 100, seeded. Pairs holding the marker or a label candidate are out.
settings_sources.labels: plan: two single-token label words drawn (label_seed) from label_candidates (frequent concrete nouns) that are single tokens and in no pool pair.
settings_sources.twin: plan: each pool token, both forms separately, gets A or B by a seeded shuffle, half each within the train tokens (and, separately, within the held-out tokens).
settings_sources.probe: plan and brief: closed-form ridge (removal.fit_ridge, lambda = 1e-3 x the mean diagonal of the residual covariance, E70's conditioner) of the 0/1 label on block l's output residual at position t of 41-token Pile windows from rows 32768-65535 (disjoint from the task rows; cached since E59), t = 20 of the window, token t-1 a train-pair word; per pair min(16, hits of each form) positions of each form, so the classes are balanced. Read as score > 0.5. Scored on the held-out-pair task windows at the trigger. Control: the same probe with label = one seeded random bit per pair (Hewitt and Liang 2019), scored on the same windows against the held-out pairs' bits.
settings_sources.fine-tune: E62's arm-A recipe as keydep.finetune runs it: Adam, anchors.FT_LR = 3e-5, batch 32, KL weight 1, clip 1, all 24 matrices, target per window (data.LAST); seeds 0 and 1; checkpoints 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000. The run stops at the scored step (the first checkpoint whose train-word accuracy reaches 0.9), which is the step that would be scored if it went on.
settings_sources.pruning: Jain et al. 2024 App. D Alg. 3 as revival_kv runs it on the 67M: grad . w of the fit windows' mean KL(W0 || state) at the trigger, per MLP unit of the up matrix; top K zeroed at every position against prune_random draws of K random units (default_rng([prune_seed, K])); K = 1, 4, 16, 64 (plan).
settings_sources.reverse: plan: the same recipe (arm A, lr 3e-5, batch 32, KL 1 to the starting state, clip 1) on the train windows' original next tokens (data.NEXT, the Pile token after the trigger's position), from the state; held-out label accuracy every 10 steps until <= 0.6, cap 300 steps, cut by the stage's time check (end 'deadline').
settings_sources.time: each stage is one debug job; stage_minutes is the time check (25 of the 30-min limit); stage 1 exits 3 before a fine-tune when less than finetune_minutes would be left (resubmit; finished states are kept).

measurements.label: y = 1 for label A, 0 for B. A window's label difference d = logit A - logit B at the trigger; the model says A when d > 0; margin m = d signed toward the window's own label (the label log-odds in nats).
measurements.P0: Possession, at W0, per block l = 0-3 (block l's output residual, readout.RESID): accuracy of the case probe on the held-out-pair task windows (label: the word before the trigger is the capitalised member); selectivity = that minus the control probe's accuracy on the same windows. l* = the earliest block before the last (l in 0-2) with accuracy >= 0.90 and selectivity >= 0.30 (both inclusive). Expected at W0: passes at some block before the last; control about 0.5.
measurements.P1: Held-out carrying (row 87): the state's label accuracy on the held-out-pair windows (1,600). Expected: W0 about 0.5; real >= 0.90; twin <= 0.65.
measurements.P2: Small function (Def 2): g = a threshold and sign on W0's case-probe score at l* (W0's residual: f_C is the original model's readout), fitted to the state's own labels (d > 0) on the train-word fit windows (1,024) by the best agreement; P2 = agreement of g with the state's labels on the held-out-pair windows. Expected: real >= 0.90; twin <= 0.65.
measurements.P3: Removal (row 81's added sentence): on the fit windows of the state's own task, G = mean(m_state - m_W0); share = mean(m_state - m_state with the probe's unit direction removed from block l*'s output residual at the trigger only) / G. Expected: real >= 0.50; twin <= 0.20. W0's own changes under the same removal (next-token loss at the probe's Pile positions, margin per task) are printed in stage 0.
measurements.do_nothing: The same share with a seeded random unit direction (removal.random_basis(d, 1, [5])) in place of the probe's, on every state, read first and alone in stage 2: <= 0.10 on every state, else stage 2 stops and no state is read.

verdict_rule: Per state: possession fails (l* is None) -> 'unreadable' (stage 0 stops; stages 1 and 2 do not run). Possession passes and P1 >= 0.90, P2 >= 0.90 and P3 >= 0.50 (the real column, inclusive) -> 'reuses C'. Possession passes and any of P1-P3 misses -> 'not through C'. A number between a real bar and a twin expectation (e.g. P3 at 0.3) reads 'not through C' as the rule says, and the number is reported; no band is added. The same rule reads every state, real or twin.

W0.P0: passes at a block before the last

edge_cases.no passing block: first_passing_block returns None: verdict 'unreadable', stage 0 exits 1 (tests/test_case_label.py).
edge_cases.passes at the last block only: does not count (Def 1's 'some layer' is before the readout is the output): None, 'unreadable'.
edge_cases.did not learn: the scored step is 1000 (learned false); P1-P3 are read as filed on that state (the twin may not learn: then P1 about 0.5 and the verdict is 'not through C').
edge_cases.no gain: G <= 0.1 nats: the P3 share is undefined (nan), reported as P3_no_gain true; P3 misses, verdict 'not through C' (the model does not perform the map). A do-nothing share on a no-gain state is no reading there and does not stop stage 2.
edge_cases.do-nothing sign: as filed, share <= 0.10, not |share|: a negative share passes.
edge_cases.g with one class: when the state gives one label on every fit window, g is the constant (threshold -inf) that returns it; P2 is the share of held-out windows with that label.
edge_cases.ties: thresholds and accuracies at a bar pass (inclusive); g's ties go to the lowest threshold, sign + before -.
edge_cases.verdict 'definition does not apply': listed in the plan; no filed case gives it here, so the code never returns it.

beside_no_rule: pruning: held-out label accuracy after zeroing the top K = 1, 4, 16, 64 MLP units (grad . w) against K random units, per state
reverse fine-tuning: held-out label accuracy every 10 steps and the first step at <= 0.6, per state
each state's summed update norm and scored step
